scientific_rationale: Single-factor region swap on the same restored state and parent program S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY. Operator pointwise, representation bridge, window [0.1,0.5], dose native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, controller unit_rms, assignment_element_cost 0.0, 40 active updates are all held fixed; only region_id and the derived atom_slots change. The pointwise operator is the smallest implemented operator that tests the hypothesis: it matches generated local points to observed teacher coordinates via Hungarian assignment and applies a robust per-point distance, so restricting support to slots [6,13,22] changes which teacher coordinates are matched and how the robust loss is distributed. No chemical-role, energy, type, affinity-head, or categorical-logit term is enabled; direct_type_force is false. The evidence clock domain is the full learning_window [0.0,0.5], distinct from the control window [0.1,0.5]. Historical Steer ancestor curves in F_b011_s030__NC/history describe teacher ancestry, not the current gradient-guided parent run, and are not used as measurements of the current controller. The source layout score is not a forecast for newly generated samples.
